title: Berlin Bridge Days 2027 - Quick Summary
items: **Four of Berlin's ten public holidays fall on a weekend in 2027.** 1 May is a Saturday, 3 October a Sunday, and both Christmas holidays land on Saturday and Sunday. Only six holidays fall on a working day.
**All six working-day holidays happen between 1 January and 17 May.** After Whit Monday there are 228 days to the end of the year with no public holiday on a weekday at all.
**Friday 7 May is the only real bridge day.** Ascension is Thursday 6 May, so one leave day buys four days off. Nothing else in 2027 comes close to that rate.

**Thirteen leave days buy thirty-two days off** if you take the Women's Day week, one Easter week, the Ascension Friday and the Whitsun week. Taking both Easter weeks costs eight days for sixteen, which is a worse rate.

**Five of the six good windows sit inside a Berlin school holiday.** Section 7 of the Bundesurlaubsgesetz gives colleagues with school-age children priority on social grounds, so those weeks are contested before you ask.
**The 9 to 12 March window is the quiet one.** Women's Day is a Monday, no Berlin school is off that week, and four leave days still return nine days off.
**Christmas 2027 costs a full week.** Both holidays are on the weekend, so being off between Christmas and New Year means buying Monday 27 to Friday 31 December outright.
